text:
Lara M: Discovered plaintext GCP service account JSON inside partner S3 payload s3://partner-prod/ingestZ/2026-04-05/debug.log (line ~12). Key id ef12ab34. Need immediate containment and rotation. @Akshay can you triage?
Akshay: On it. Immediate runbook: 1) disable the exposed key 2) delete key after verifying no active use 3) rotate Vault secret and rewrap with KMS 4) tighten IAM & set short TTLs 5) enable/confirm Vault/KMS audit logs. Disabling now.
Jamie P: Platform note: we should add an ingest-side validator to block uploads containing patterns like "private_key" and auto-quarantine. I'll open an emergency ticket.
Ben J: I'll kick off repo/CI scans for the SA email and grep for private_key occurrences: `rg \"redwood-ingest@project|private_key\" || true`. Also scanning audit logs for Unwrap/Decrypt calls.
sre-bot: Alert created `vault.read.anomaly.ingestz` -> webhook to #incidents. Quarantine job scheduled for the S3 object.
Akshay: Disabled key ef12ab34 at 2026-04-05T16:02:10Z. Fingerprint SHA256:DEADBEEF00112233. Deleted key after verification. Spun up new SA redwood-ingest-ingestz@project with least-priv and generated new key. Wrapped new key with our KMS and wrote to `secret/partners/ingestz/sa-v2`.
Jamie P: Pushing a temporary Vault policy to deny CI runner service accounts read access to `secret/partners/ingestz/*` until rotation completes and smoke tests pass.
Ben J: Updated CI/Ansible env refs to `sa-v2` and running smoke tests across staging. Also running a 24h log monitor for suspicious auth from partner IP ranges.
Lara M: Partner & CS notified, legal looped in. Please paste deletion confirmation and fingerprint for the incident doc.
Akshay: Confirmed deletion and fingerprint posted above. Also kicked off a job to rewrap old backups and rotate cached tokens; restarted ingest workers to pick up new creds.
Ben J: Proposed follow-up: 1) postmortem + RCA within 72h 2) require KMS-wrapped or WIF-based partner ingest in 30 days 3) add pre-ingest scanner in next sprint. I'll open PRs for automation where possible.
Jamie P: I'll own the platform remediation ticket and the ingest validator. Adding policy to require envelope encryption or short-lived tokens for partner uploads.
Lara M: Leaving thread open for any anomalous re-reads or downstream failures. :white_check_mark:
